scope: Primary-source research for the next valid codec gap: AAC-LD AOT23 plus attached LD-MPS. No implementation or playback acceptance is claimed here.
facts: AAC-LD uses AOT23; attached LDSpatialSpecificConfig is carried in the ASC.
The sync extension identifier is0x7cc, followed by ldmpsPresentFlag1. A present configuration has length8;255 adds16 bits.
AAC-LD spatial payload uses EXT_LDSAC_DATA like AAC-ELD, without SBR.
AOT44 denotes a separate LD-MPS object, not an alias for the AAC-LD core.

code_inspection.finding: AOT23 tail currently expects only0x2b7 SBR discovery; no0x7cc dispatcher.
LD core skips ER extensions and returns core PCM without spatial dispatch or source-timescale argument.

required_acceptance: Own short synthetic movie before changing admission
ASC length bounds and correct output channels/clock
LD core PCM to owned LD-QMF and existing session
Independent/compositional PCM control with disclosed boundary
Playback, seek, rewind, repeated ranges, late-error rollback
Keep SBR prohibition for AAC-LD and unqualified residual domains explicit
